field_notes.name: field_notes
field_notes.default: 'Everything recorded at the temples: what happened, in words, photographs and videos.'

films.name: films
films.default: 'Finished short films, such as the Centre’s Instagram reels. New Instagram posts arrive here as drafts every morning.'

articles.name: articles
articles.default: 'Essays and finished pieces. Tag a temple or festival only if the article actually discusses it.'

media.name: media
media.default: 'Every photo, video, recording and document. Drag several files in at once to upload them together.'

temples.name: temples
temples.default: 'The temples being documented, in the order the site shows them — drag to reorder. Open a temple to edit everything on its page.'

temple_pieces.name: temple_pieces
temple_pieces.default: 'Short finished pieces for the "The temple" and "The people" sections of temple pages, polished from the field notes.'

occasions.name: occasions
occasions.default: 'Every occasion the team was present for. These make each temple''s ''year so far'', and the ''where we''ve seen it'' list on festival pages.'

drawings.name: drawings
drawings.default: 'Abishek''s drawings: each temple''s illustrated plan, and scenes photographs can''t capture. A drawing appears at the top of every temple and festival page it is tagged with.'

observances.name: observances
observances.default: 'Each festival or ritual is explained once. Its page then gathers every temple, date, field note and article tagged with it.'

books.name: books
books.default: 'The outline shown on The Book page. It will change as the writing does.'

users.name: users
users.default: 'Everyone who can sign in. Admins add people here and choose what they can do.'

regions.name: regions
regions.default: 'The towns the project documents. Only Pondicherry for now.'

home_page.name: home_page
home_page.default: 'The words on the home page. The newest additions, temples and festivals shown there fill themselves in. "Save" puts changes on the site.'

about_page.name: about_page
about_page.default: 'Everything on the About page. Drag sections to reorder them. "Save" puts changes on the site.'

instagram.name: instagram
instagram.default: 'New Instagram videos arrive every morning as draft films, marked "awaiting review". Nothing appears on the site until someone checks the temples, festivals and consent, and publishes it.'
